assertions.description: Command configuration, trust-plane routing, structured output, exit codes, and selected-fleet reconciliation are independently specified.
Seven production/test pairs, family prefixes, and focused test repositories are unique, safe, and drift-checked.
Preview is the default; repository creation requires an explicit apply operation and the primary GitHub identity.
Manual live verification checks an exact private ores-cli ref only through the approved secret channel and fails closed when unavailable.
Live status is forbidden until hosted private-source and organization probes retain redacted evidence.
